title: Surreal AI Dance Video - Saffron and Smoke - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
👉 I post new AI art and cinematic videos every day — subscribe to follow the journey.

Saffron and Smoke. A Monday morning dance party at the spice market. Why? I have no idea 😜 Was playing around with style ref codes in #Midjourney last night and really loved the contrast of these characters on the black background with these beautiful muted colors. The images reminded me of some kind of international market in like Morocco. So I came up with this song using @suno to go with it. Animated using #VEO3. 

#ai #aiart #aivideo #TribalHouse #Weirdcore #GenerativeArt #SaffronAndSmoke #OriginalMusic #SunoAI #MidjourneyArt #FolkSurrealism #DeepHouse #GlobalBass #Visualizer #CostumeDesign #FantasyArt #KellyBoeschAIArt #NewMusic

top_comments.author: @sundog3150
top_comments.text: I am almost 80. Since Covid I have been in an artistic slump. I thought my days of being an artist were over. I was falling into a mild depression because I need 5hat creativity to connect with my soul. Then the algorithm sent me this video one morning. I sat stunned. I watched it multiple times, it’s as if I could not get enough of it. It was feeding my creativity. I could feel myself waking up. I went out to my poor abandoned studio on the second floor of the barn and looked around. It was like discovering a secret space. I wanted to make it mine. I moved everything around, driven to create a new working space. I felt renewed. So I thank you from the bottom of my heart for this beautiful art that YOU do. It offers more than just visual pleasure it has a healing energy to it perhaps unbeknownst to you. I am creating again and my soul and I are dancing in delight again. Thank you.❤
